_comment: Ambient air temperature (AAT) sensor signal - STP 8.3.3.9: record the RMS voltage of the signal on CH1. Single channel, 1 V/div, vertical position -3.5 div, 1 ms/div, edge trigger on CH1 rising at an EXPLICIT 2.5 V level, AUTO (free-run) mode. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts. The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. WINDOW: pass duration_s=0.01 to configure_scope for this test (0.01 s total = 0.001 s/div x 10).
name: ambient_air_temp
